about.text: A matured goat cheese of Andalusia, named after the Murciano-Granadina breed. On a Cádiz farm it is made from raw goat milk with kid rennet, pressed and ripened 60 days; a pilot-plant version uses pasteurised milk and a lactic starter.

sources.text: Pilot-plant lactose-reduced cheese, Córdoba, making details; Benaocaz (Cádiz) farm cheese making, 60-day ripening.
